args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy one.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was approved and rolled out successfully.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the health check failures, and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed the service is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
